text:
cass: quick heads-up: planned staging rollout tomorrow 02:45 UTC touching API header-split, router parse-buffer change, and console routing rules. proposing runtime pin for the window and a deploy hold until canary and prewarm look good.
noah: +1. last run shard-5 saw parse_overflow + KV evictions with header >3.8kb.
noah: logs: [staging-router] WARN parse_overflow id=shard-5; [staging-runtime] INFO kv_eviction count=34 reason=header_pressure
mia: recommend pin runtime v2.15.3 (has soft buffer clamp) and disable console split FF in staging during warmup. add a transient alert on `kv_eviction_rate` and `router.parse_overflow`.
olivia: rollback rules: abort if 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.02 for 5m OR session.reset_rate doubles. also abort if canary p95 >550ms for 10m.
cass: proposed warmup: start prewarm 25m prior, then 30%->70%->100% traffic over 15m. deploy-bot hold command below.
cass: `/deploy hold staging --reason "header-split-safety" --by cass --until 1765011800`
deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2024-11-08T02:45Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
noah: quick smoke now with heavy headers (~4.0kb): first pass 5xx 1.3%, after a tiny router tweak 0.3%. posting short snippets.
mia: grafana temp panels up: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/parse-quick . watching `router.parse_overflow`, `kv_eviction_rate`, `api.header_size_p95`.
cass: pin runtime -> v2.15.3 and placing the hold now. will keep console FF off.
cass: (running) `/deploy hold staging --reason "header-split-safety"`
deploy-bot: hold placed by cass at 1765010055 (reason: header-split-safety)
mia: running prewarm on shard-5 now. deploy-bot will report when done.
deploy-bot: prewarm accepted; ETA ~11m.
noah: smoke after prewarm: 5xx 0.18%, kv_eviction_rate 0.007. within thresholds.
olivia: lift criteria: 15m stable canary with 5xx <0.2% and kv_eviction_rate <0.01 and p50 <320ms. any breach -> immediate rollback. keep updates short here for oncall.
mia: prewarm finished (deploy-bot id 1765010201). starting warmup ramp 25m prior.
cass: thanks all. i'll unhold after the 15m stability window and post the release id."
